unresolvedGlyphs.note: The camera viewfinder's frame on the MAP board. The design added the held-frame panel on 2026-09-08; the app draws no camera rectangle yet.
Same panel as above — the viewfinder's second mark, which arrives with it.

The SOUND steppers' caret. The app draws this silhouette under `caret-up`, on the 24 grid; the design draws it in a box tight around the ink, and matching rasterises each through its own viewBox — the same shape under two box conventions cannot meet.
The foundations gallery's own outline bell. Every bell the design actually places is the solid one, which is what the app draws — see DISAGREEMENTS in the target profile.

The direction mark on a rim puck. Drawn, as `caret-{up,down,left,right}`: the kit puts it on the 24 grid, the design draws it in a 4x7 box tight around the ink, and matching rasterises each through its own viewBox — so the same shape under two box conventions cannot meet. Fifteen of the design's drawings use a tight box and are unmatchable this way; this is the first one anybody redrew.
The same, downward. See the note on the caret above.
A sparkline on the CODE board's new PERF tab. The app has no performance graph; the tab arrived with the 2026-09-08 canvas.
The heap trace beside the sparkline above, and absent for the same reason.

The controller on the CONTROLS card. The design shades a body and paints its four face buttons in four accents; the app draws one monochrome line instead. Deliberate: the picture sits beside a table that names those same four faces, so two things competed for one glance, and colouring the faces asserts which face is which colour — something no two controllers agree on.
